claims.title: Carpet cleaning
claims.reasoning: The lease does not require professional or move-out cleaning by the tenant. Normal wear and tear is excluded.

claims.title: Wall repainting
claims.reasoning: Clause 2 explicitly states the landlord is responsible for repainting upon expiration of the lease.

claims.title: Trash removal
claims.reasoning: No move-out cleaning requirement is specified in the lease clauses.
